lead: Short links lead to problems, contests, posts, users and organizations. Anyone makes automatic links; here you choose codes, set expiry and delete.

form.title: Create a link
form.pathHint: For example /contests/hsg26 or /problems/aplusb, without a query string.
form.codeHint: 3–32 characters: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens. Leave empty for a random code.
form.expiresPast: The expiry must be after now.
form.pathRefused: Only problem, contest, post, user and organization pages of this site can be shortened.

confirm.title: Delete the link /s/{code}?
confirm.body: Visitors of this link will see the not-found page. This cannot be undone.

title: Short links
